page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 16 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9555 processor. This x86_64 architecture CPU features 16 physical cores operating at 2.0 GHz with a single thread per core and shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 80.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU featuring 96 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage and runs on the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in single-core operations, including stress-ng single-core CPU tests, Geekbench single-core scores, and single-threaded compression and decompression. Large-block memory bandwidth is also in the top tier, reaching 444.94 GB/sec for read-only and 279.59 GB/sec for write operations. Multi-core performance, multi-threaded decompression, and image processing are rated as strong. In LLM inference benchmarks, the server achieves top-tier speeds for both prompt processing and text generation using small (135M) and medium (7B) models, though no data is available for large (70B) models.

Given the high-density GPU memory of 96 GB VRAM paired with a moderate 16-vCPU allocation, this server offers qualitative resource density efficiency for GPU-bound tasks that do not require massive multi-core CPU scaling. The lack of local storage requires external storage attachments, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This configuration is highly suited for medium-scale LLM inference, image processing, and GPU-accelerated data science workloads.
